title: New Zealand Adventure
name: New Zealand
stays: Millennium Queenstown · Scenic Franz Josef · Sudima Christchurch
p1: Nine days and eight nights from Queenstown to Christchurch. Cruise Lake Wakatipu on the TSS Earnslaw, taste wine at Kinross, ride the Shotover Jet, cross the Southern Alps on the TranzAlpine train, and paddle a waka on the Avon River.
p2: Eight nights of hotels, group airport transfers, guides, transportation and every listed experience are included, with 8 breakfasts, 2 lunches and a dinner.
presImg: Autumn colors along the water in Queenstown
presText: Five nights in Queenstown give you time to settle in: a gourmet BBQ lunch at Walter Peak High Country Farm, the Skyline Gondola and Stratosfare lunch, and an afternoon in Arrowtown.
staysLine: Three hotels · Queenstown, Franz Josef + Christchurch
